drivers: Mixed refinery outages and restarts (Deer Park outage vs Flint Hills, Valero restarts)
Petcoke rally above US$100 on energy complex strength
outlooks.summary: Supply signals are balanced: some refinery outages are offset by several coker restarts, and the headline score is near zero. Price is down 16% over 3 months, though the recent rally and high freight rates add some firmness.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch how quickly Deer Park and Lytton return to service, and whether US Gulf freight rates ease.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应信号基本平衡:部分炼厂停产被多家焦化装置复产所抵消,综合得分接近零。价格三个月下跌16%,但近期反弹和高运费带来一定支撑。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停产与复产并存(Deer Park停产,Flint Hills、Valero复产)
能源板块走强,石油焦急涨至100美元以上
运费高企抑制美国出口
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注Deer Park和Lytton炼厂复产速度,以及美湾运费是否回落。

drivers: DRC export quotas cutting output (Glencore cobalt down 52%)
China export-control deadlines and critical-mineral tensions
outlooks.summary: DRC quotas are sharply cutting supply, a clear bullish factor. Price has fallen 24% in 3 months, so shortage may not be fully priced in, though quota details are still evolving.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch DRC quota allocations and Q4 export volumes, plus China's export-control decisions.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)配额大幅压缩供应(嘉能可钴产量下降52%),明显利多。价格三个月已下跌24%,短缺可能尚未完全计价,但配额细则仍在变化。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)出口配额削减产量(嘉能可钴产量降52%)
中国出口管制截止日期与关键矿产紧张局势
价格三个月已下跌24%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)配额分配、第四季度出口量以及中国出口管制决定。

drivers: Copper-moly major slowing molybdenum output growth
outlooks.summary: A major producer is slowing moly output growth and export-control risk persists. Price is already up 18% in 3 months and 42% in 12 months, so part of the tightness is priced in, but further upside is possible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's export-control decisions and by-product moly output from major copper miners.
outlooks.summary_zh: 一家大型生产商放缓钼产量增长,出口管制风险仍在。价格三个月已涨18%、12个月涨42%,部分紧张已被计价,但仍有上行空间。
drivers_zh: 铜钼大型企业放缓钼产量增长
中国出口管制不确定性
价格三个月上涨18%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口管制决定以及大型铜矿的副产钼产量。

drivers: Generic China export-control headlines, little lithium-specific news
outlooks.summary: Headlines are mostly broad critical-mineral news with little lithium-specific supply disruption. New upstream capacity from CATL is mildly bearish, so we see no clear shortage signal.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch lithium mine and brine supply updates and China's export-control decisions.
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻多为泛关键矿产消息,缺少锂的具体供应中断。宁德时代扩大上游资源略偏利空,暂无明确短缺信号。
drivers_zh: 中国出口管制的泛泛报道,缺少锂的具体消息
宁德时代扩大上游锂资源
价格三个月下跌13%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注锂矿和盐湖供应动态以及中国出口管制决定。

drivers: China extended export-control pause to January/2027
outlooks.summary: Yttrium is tight, with Japan months from running out, and controls on Japan remain. China's two-month pause on new controls eases near-term risk, but the deadline returns in January.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for any China announcement on the extended pause and yttrium shipments to Japan.
outlooks.summary_zh: 钇供应紧张,日本库存仅够数月,对日管制仍在。中国将新管制暂停延长两个月,缓解短期风险,但1月将再次面临截止期限。
drivers_zh: 对日本的钇供应“停滞”
中国对日本实施出口管制
中国将出口管制暂停延至1月/2027年
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国关于延长暂停的正式公告以及对日本的钇出货情况。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts squeezing supply
outlooks.summary: Supply disruption in Congo and Indonesia and demand outrunning refined supply point to a tight market. Price is up 56% in 12 months, so some is priced in, but 3-month change is flat and risks remain upward.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Bisie (Congo) output and Indonesian export volumes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)和印尼的供应中断,加上需求增长快于精炼锡供应,市场偏紧。价格12个月上涨56%,部分已被计价,但三个月基本持平,风险仍偏上行。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)冲突和印尼减产挤压供应
需求增长快于精炼供应
价格12个月上涨56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)Bisie锡矿产量和印尼出口量。

outlooks.summary: Export-deadline news adds some supply risk, but price is down 56% over 12 months and headlines are generic. Without a specific disruption, we stay neutral.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the antimony export deadline outcome and any Chinese export-licence changes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口截止日期临近带来一定供应风险,但价格12个月下跌56%,且新闻较为泛泛。没有具体中断事件,维持中性。
drivers_zh: 中国出口截止日期临近
关键矿产政策的泛泛新闻
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注锑出口截止日期的结果以及中国出口许可变化。

drivers: Rising indium prices and tight minor-metal supply
outlooks.summary: China's export-control deadlines and tight minor-metal supply keep supply risk high. Price is already up 67% in 3 months, so much is priced in, but deadlines could push it further.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's November 27 deadline and any licensing changes for gallium and germanium.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国出口管制截止日期和小金属供应偏紧使供应风险居高。价格三个月已涨67%,大部分已被计价,但截止日期可能推动进一步上涨。
drivers_zh: 中国出口管制截止日期(11月27日,镓)
铟价上涨,小金属供应偏紧
价格三个月上涨67%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注11月27日截止日期以及镓、锗的许可政策变化。

drivers: Rising anode costs and feedstock rally
outlooks.summary: Refinery outages and restarts roughly offset, with a near-zero supply score. Higher anode costs and freight support firmness, and price is already up 15%, so we see no clear shortage.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US Gulf coker restarts and anode feedstock prices.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂停产与复产大致抵消,供应得分接近零。阳极成本上升和运费高企带来支撑,价格已上涨15%,暂无明确短缺。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停产与复产并存
阳极成本上升、原料走强
运费挤压美国出口
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美湾焦化装置复产和阳极原料价格。

outlooks.summary: Supply headlines are balanced and the score is near zero. The recent petcoke rally and freight pressure give some support, but no clear shortage is visible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch refinery turnaround schedules and freight rates over the next month.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应新闻基本平衡,得分接近零。近期石油焦反弹和运费压力提供一定支撑,但未见明确短缺。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停产与复产并存
石油焦反弹至100美元以上
价格三个月下跌5%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注未来一个月炼厂检修计划和运费走势。
